title: Aurora Wireless Headphones
fullDescription:
Aurora wraps you in rich, balanced audio with active noise cancellation tuned by recording engineers. A 40-hour battery, plush memory-foam ear cushions, and seamless multi-device pairing make it the only pair you'll reach for.

Includes a hard travel case, USB-C charging cable, and 3.5mm aux line.

title: Linen Everyday Shirt
fullDescription: Cut from heavyweight European linen and pre-washed for softness, the Everyday Shirt wears beautifully from morning meetings to weekend dinners. Mother-of-pearl buttons, French side seams, and a slightly extended hem keep things polished.

title: Ceramic Pour-Over Set
fullDescription: A hand-finished ceramic dripper paired with a borosilicate carafe. The wide ribbed cone improves extraction, while the matte glaze keeps things grippy and modern on your counter.

title: The Quiet Craft (Hardcover)
shortDescription: Essays on making things that matter.
fullDescription: A collected volume of essays by designers, writers, and engineers on the practice of doing focused work. 312 pages, smyth-sewn binding, with full-color plates throughout.

title: Trailhead Running Shoes
shortDescription: Cushioned, grippy, ready for any trail.
fullDescription: Trailhead pairs a responsive EVA midsole with a sticky rubber outsole engineered for mixed terrain. A breathable mesh upper keeps feet cool over long miles.

title: Nimbus Smart Lamp
fullDescription: Nimbus blends form and function with a sculpted aluminum body and a full warm-to-cool tunable LED. Schedule routines, dim with a tap, and pair effortlessly with your favorite assistant.

title: Merino Crew Sweater
fullDescription: A featherweight merino wool sweater that resists odor and wrinkles. Reinforced shoulders and a ribbed crew neck hold their shape after many wears and washes.

title: Stoneware Dinner Set (12pc)
fullDescription: A complete service for four in soft sand glaze. Microwave and dishwasher safe, with a subtle hand-thrown texture that makes every piece a little different.

title: Yoga Mat — Cork & Rubber
shortDescription: Natural grip that improves with sweat.
fullDescription: A 5mm natural cork surface bonded to a recycled rubber base. Cork's antimicrobial properties keep your practice clean; the grip actually gets better as you warm up.
